math.blur: target=uniform mean(old self and unique neighbors)
math.fixed_points: Return exact old bits for strength0, Sharpen ±zero/0.5/1, and rounded numeric equality. No unintended signed-zero normalization.
math.graph: Unique undirected nonself indexed triangle edges; no spatial coordinate welding. Neighbor summation order ascending IDs, self included once.
math.graph_blend: old + strength*(target-old), f64 arithmetic from previous-pass f32 values, round to f32 synchronously after each pass.
math.isolated: Grow/Shrink/Blur isolated points remain bit-identical; Sharpen is pointwise including isolated points.
math.report: Count final f32 bit differences relative to original masks; max_abs_change uses f64 differences of final/input f32 values, not accumulated passes.
math.sharpen: clamp(0.5 + (m-0.5)*(1+strength),0,1), f64 arithmetic then f32; no extra graph blend and no graph allocation.
